trust_boundary: Packaged manifest and managed Python environment are trusted. Verify all artifact bytes before deserialization; vendored model code is compiled from verified bytes, not imported from its directory. No downloads or installation occur in this adapter. Model directory must remain read-only during inference.

balanced.title: Balanced
balanced.summary: Mel-Band RoFormer vocals and fine-tuned Hybrid Transformer Demucs drums; harmonics are the remainder so the three parts sum to the track.

fast.title: Fast
fast.summary: Hybrid Transformer Demucs for vocals and drums in one pass; harmonics are the remainder.

umxhq.title: Light
umxhq.summary: Open-Unmix HQ on the CPU for machines without a GPU and with little memory; lower separation quality.

torch.download_bytes_note: win32 cu128 and cpu sizes are the measured wheel sizes for CPython 3.11 on 2026-10-10; other entries are estimates that include the CUDA runtime packages pulled on Linux.

dependency_policy: These are direct version constraints, not approval of an unresolved wheel graph. Root builder owns the complete tested lock, hashes and third-party notices, including separate GPU vendor terms.
